title: Fishing Guide Austin - Bass Fishing Guide

services.name: Fishing Guide Austin
services.desc: Spring and fall are considered by many fishermen as the prime times for fishing for largemouth on Lake Austin - or most any other lake, but black bass can and are sought after (and caught!) year round. Your Lake Austin fishing guide uses a variety of styles to hook black bass, depending on what time of year it is, local bait activity, current weather conditions, water temperature, etc. When bass are suspended over points, drop-offs or structure of any kind, top-water lures can be just the ticket to get the fish to strike on the surface.
